hero.subtitle: AceCue listens, thinks, and feeds you the right words — live or in practice. Bring any AI model, keep your data, pay nothing to start.
hero.honest: Honest by design: it can't hide from full-screen sharing, and Practice Mode is always fair game.

distinction.title: Two ways to use AceCue
distinction.subtitle: One copilot, two moments. Pick the one in front of you.
distinction.liveBody: Captures your meeting tab's audio, detects the interviewer's question, and shows a fast answer in a discreet floating window over Zoom, Meet or Teams. This is the real live experience.
distinction.liveF1: Silent tab-audio capture — no screen picker
distinction.liveF2: Discreet overlay floats above Zoom, Meet, Teams
distinction.webBody: No install. Run realistic mock interviews, configure your models and résumé, and rehearse answers. You can also do live in the browser by sharing your meeting tab's audio — but the plugin overlay is smoother.
distinction.webF1: Realistic mock interviews with instant feedback
distinction.webF2: Set up keys, résumé and the job once — used everywhere
distinction.webF3: Works in English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어
distinction.honest: Honest note: a browser plugin cannot hide itself from full-screen screen-sharing. It stays private when you share a single tab, not your whole screen. AceCue never pretends to be invisible.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: AceCue captures your meeting tab's audio and transcribes it live — nothing is recorded or stored.
how.step2Body: The moment the interviewer finishes asking, AceCue isolates the actual question from the chatter.
how.step3Body: A response tailored to your résumé and the job appears in about a second. Glance, speak, move on.

models.title: Bring any model
models.body: Paste one key — AceCue detects the provider automatically and shows the right options.

privacySec.title: Private by architecture
privacySec.body: AceCue is built so your interview never leaves your hands.
privacySec.p1: API keys live only in your browser — never on our servers.
privacySec.p2: Audio is transcribed in real time and never recorded or stored.
privacySec.p3: Your résumé and job context stay on your device unless you opt into sync.
privacySec.cta: Read the full Privacy & Ethics page

ethics.title: Use it honestly
ethics.body: AceCue is a preparation and accessibility aid — built especially for non-native speakers, neurodivergent candidates, and anyone who interviews better with a little structure. Practice Mode is always 100% legitimate. In live mode, treat it like glancing at your own notes: some interviews are screen-shared or recorded, and using undisclosed assistance may break an employer's rules. You decide what's appropriate. We won't pretend it's invisible.
ethics.practiceLegit: Practice Mode is always fair game.

onboard.title: Capture your interview audio
onboard.body: To hear the interviewer in the browser, AceCue uses your tab's audio. When the picker opens, choose the meeting tab and turn on "Share tab audio".
onboard.step2: Pick the Zoom / Meet / Teams tab
onboard.extHint: Tip: the Chrome plugin captures audio silently with no picker — and floats over your call.
